mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate signals an ongoing monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening to combat high inflation, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return prediction fails when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise simultaneously in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rising federal funds rate increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 50% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300 thousand units, it signals robust residential construction activity that indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1300, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, high housing starts (HOUST > 1300) signal overbuilding and potential economic overheating, which triggers a market correction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 50% of periods during late-cycle expansions when HOUST > 1300, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
